expectations.text: Notes the suspension is a pause, not a cancellation — the 48 CFR rule and program structure remain, and outcomes could range from restructuring to redesign
expectations.evidence: The suspension is explicitly framed as a pause pending review, not a repeal... could recommend restoring a modified third-party assessment model; DFARS clause family (7012/7019/7020/7021)... remain in force

expectations.text: Advises contractors to continue 800-171 implementation regardless — it remains contractually required and any successor regime builds on it
expectations.evidence: Continue all NIST SP 800-171 remediation work on your existing timeline. Nothing in the suspension touches your underlying safeguarding obligations under DFARS 7012
